section_2_arm_configuration_plan.budget_law: The rubric allows max 2 families x 3 arms = 6 cells. Exactly one family is ELIGIBLE, so this freeze books its 3 arm cells and the remaining 3 cells stay UNBOOKED -- never padded with new families, sibling proposals, re-runs or threshold variants invented after any measurement. Control-battery cell accounting at I follows the D1 control_battery_spec and A1 adjudication law within the unbooked budget; it can never exceed 6 booked cells total.
section_2_arm_configuration_plan.variant_law: The 3 arms are frozen parameter variants of the ONE declared rule family (curvature-gated slope on the level-orthogonalized curve shape): neutral + conservative + aggressive gate variants fixed by the rule form (symmetric double-sort with median cuts = the D2 frozen neutral defaults; outer-quartile cuts = stricter gate; single-coordinate OR gate = higher-activity gate). No variant was chosen with reference to any measurement; quantile cuts are statistics of the state-input series only (D2 neutral-default convention 2).

shared_arm_law.decomposition_basis: slope = 30 Yr - 2 Yr; curvature = 2 Yr - 2 x 10 Yr + 30 Yr; level coordinate = 10 Yr; all from the S5 official par-yield CSV row at the decision instant's readable bar (columns frozen in the D2 commit-1 neutral defaults; carried across the whole grid window per the D2 feasibility renote).
shared_arm_law.orthogonalization_law: PIT-expanding OLS (with intercept) of each shape coordinate on the level coordinate, fitted ONLY on strictly-past bookable instants; residual at the instant is the orthogonalized coordinate; min_past_points 63 (D2 frozen); instants before the first fit are UNDEFINED, never inferred (Q-11).

leg_pair_freeze.law: D1 declared the bucket-pair mapping SYMBOLIC until D2/S selection; frozen HERE by tenor-bracket proximity, never by performance: the declared slope tenors 30 Yr and 2 Yr map to the unique duration-bracket cover in the frozen leg set -- 2 Yr -> SHY (1-3 Yr track), 30 Yr -> TLT (20+ Yr track). IEF/IEI are reserve legs of the P0 census, unmapped.

shared_arm_law.sign_convention: state +1 => LONG front-bucket leg (SHY) / SHORT long-bucket leg (TLT); state -1 => reverse; state 0 => flat. Fixed convention frozen here (global sign flip is |rho|-invariant per the D2 sign-convention law); never tuned.
shared_arm_law.entry_clock_law: P1 clock law: entry at the 16:00 America/New_York close of each bookable decision session (21:00Z EST / 20:00Z EDT, DST via zoneinfo); the shape state is formed ONLY from curve rows PIT-available under the V7 close+1 readable-bar law materialized in p2_grid_census.json bookable_instants.
shared_arm_law.exit_law: force-flat after holding_trading_days = 5 common-grid sessions (p1_cost_contract frozen holding); overlapping state changes resolve last-write-wins (D2 frozen overlap law).
shared_arm_law.cost_treatment: identical frozen tier-2.0 treatment for every arm and every battery control; BOTH legs charged once per fill (section 4).
shared_arm_law.grid_law: all arms and battery controls run on the identical p2_grid_census.json bookable_instants grid (1918 instants) and window.

This is the exact state form whose decision-state series D2 screened (pooled |rho| 0.13897602158106126 <= ceiling 0.2).

gate.cut_series_law: sample quantiles of the STATE-INPUT series over the 1918 bookable instants only (D2 neutral-default convention 2: no outcome, no scored number enters the state machinery)
gate.quantile_method: linear interpolation on the sorted state-input series

arms.variant_rationale: CONSERVATIVE variant: the stricter-gate member of the same double-sort bucket family -- symmetric outer-quartile cuts (state +1 iff BOTH orthogonalized coordinates strictly above their sample 75th percentile, -1 iff BOTH strictly below their sample 25th percentile, else 0). Wider symmetric buckets mean fewer, more extreme state activations. Fixed by the rule form (symmetric quartile double-sort); zero free parameters chosen from any measurement; never tuned.

arms.variant_rationale: AGGRESSIVE variant: the higher-activity member of the same family -- single-coordinate gate (logical OR instead of AND: +1 iff EITHER orthogonalized coordinate strictly above its sample median, -1 iff EITHER strictly below, else 0). Fixed by the rule form; never tuned.

section_3_stage_a_rule_order_frozen.provenance_note: Rule order R1-R6 adapted from the FOREX-NG1 selection-freeze precedent (stage_a_rule_order_frozen block, commit d0992d17df8e2dfde57c9a0806a5798f14021a4f, content sha256 5d7eb5793e02e7919d59ba16a9fa8c3041e3d7e23274c605fbec639c81d2c8ee) under plans/PLAN_crypto_ng1.md sec7 law; adaptations: this cycle's window/folds, the frozen tier-2.0 cost contract, R2 restated as this family's own declared executioner (D1 falsification rule), R6 unit adapted from event to decision instant (lane A5 is grid-only). No threshold was moved: the numbers 0 / 2-of-3 / 1.10 / 50% carry over unchanged from the precedent.
rules: R1 EXPECTANCY: after-cost expectancy > 0 per decision at the frozen tier-2.0 cost treatment (PRIMARY), on the identical bookable grid and window.

R2 CONTROL_KILL (declared executioner, V8 law adapted): if the MANDATORY level-vs-shape decomposition control arm (the same decomposition's LEVEL coordinate traded with the identical leg-pair machinery, grid and cost treatment) earns a strictly greater after-cost per-decision edge than the anchor arm it is paired against, the family fails -- the shape state did not survive orthogonalization against the level factor and the mechanism is a re-clocked DGS10-level form (falsification-by-control #14 FX-V8 / #15 FOREX-NG1 CTL-DGS10LEVEL class). The clock-only shadow and the misaligned-state placebo carry the same out-earning kill semantics as secondary executioners (D1 falsification rule).

R3 FOLDS: at least 2 of 3 temporal folds with positive after-cost expectancy; folds frozen by equal calendar-day thirds of the bookable window 2019-01-07..2026-09-11 (2804 days): fold-1 2019-01-07..2021-07-28, fold-2 2021-07-29..2024-02-18, fold-3 2024-02-19..2026-09-11; force-flat at fold ends.
R4 PROFIT FACTOR: profit factor >= 1.10 with margin recorded (P-2).

R5 STRESS: after-cost expectancy under the stress-tier cost treatment still > 0. Disclosed coincidence: the RATES-NG1 frozen ladder has a single tier, tier 2.0 (CS p90 spread + ACT/365F expense drag), which is both PRIMARY and the stress ceiling, so R5's treatment coincides with R1's; the rule is retained for rule-order fidelity with the ng1 precedent, never silently dropped.

R6 NON_CONCENTRATION: drop-one-fold survival + no single decision instant contributing more than 50% of gross (unit adapted from the precedent's 'event' to 'decision instant': lane A5 consumes no events).
